title: meliosma lepidota subsp. vulcanica
intro: Meliosma lepidota subsp. vulcanica, commonly known as Vulcan's Meliosma, is a plant species that belongs to the family Annonaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used in the Philippines to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its multiple health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vulcan's Meliosma include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
